resources.string: A reimplementation of Apple Music Sing mode for Android with on-device Hardware accelerated stem separation.
What’s New in Sing for Android
Hardware acceleration libraries now download only when needed for your device, reducing the app’s storage footprint by up to 96%.
More models, and a better selection screen
Sing for Android now supports more lightweight models, and the UI for choosing one is less cluttered.
Blur unfocused lines, center chorus lyrics, and optionally use Apple’s English translation when one isn’t available in your system language.
Spectral processing preserves backing vocals and stereo effects more faithfully, with improved mono compatibility.
Sing for Android now looks for updates automatically and shows you what’s has changed in a pop-up view.
Select the neural model architecture for real-time vocal isolation and attenuation.

• Apple Sing (Vi-NNet): Official Apple Music Sing model. It runs entirely on CPU through a custom C++ engine, hence it's included in the app solely for reference and for comparisons with other models.
• Kim Inst (MDX-Net, 3072 bins): High-fidelity model covering the full 22.05 kHz spectrum for s bleed-free instrumental stem extraction.
• UVR MDX-NET 1-9703 (2048 bins): Ultra-lightweight model with low-ish latency and minimal battery consumption, ideal for sustained real-time playback.
• ONNX Runtime (Hexagon HTP NPU & CPU): Recommended for Qualcomm Snapdragon processors equipped with a Hexagon HTP NPU (FP16), or high-performance multi-threaded CPUs (FP32).
• Alibaba MNN (OpenCL / Vulkan / NNAPI / CPU): Recommended for all other devices, providing cross-platform hardware acceleration across Qualcomm Adreno, ARM Mali, and Samsung Xclipse GPUs. Qualcomm Hexagon acceleration is also supported, but with lower performance than ONNX (~25% less).
• FP16 vs FP32: FP16 halves memory bandwidth and is required for NPU acceleration. FP32 provides exact full precision and prevents underflow on GPUs and powerful CPUs. Running an FP32 model under NPU acceleration will usually result in an on-the-fly FP16 quantization, hence prequantized models are provided.
Uses a spectral center cut to preserve backing vocals, reverb, and vocoder widening and other stereo effects.

Unlocks 0% vocal floor (full mute) and allows to be set to 100% without disabling Sing Mode.
Overrides server-side restrictions and missing lyrics timing to allow Sing on all tracks.
